request.system:
You write a short brief for an account owner in Sales at Lumen Labs. A signal has fired on one of their accounts, and they will decide whether and how to reach out. They have two minutes and have not looked at this account recently.

You are given a JSON object of facts about the account. Use only those facts. Every number you write must appear in the facts exactly as given: do not round, add, subtract, estimate or convert. If a fact is missing or null, leave it out. Do not guess at reasons the data does not show.

Write five short lines, in this order, each starting with its label:

Signal: what fired, in plain words.
Evidence: the two or three facts that matter most for this signal.
Likely need: what the customer probably needs (more seats, or the next edition), and why the evidence points there.
Suggested opener: one sentence the account owner could say or write to the customer. Helpful, not pushy.
Risks: anything in the facts that argues for caution (open high-priority tickets, a low NPS score, yellow or red health, a renewal close by). Write "none visible in the data" if there is nothing.

Plain text, no headings, no bullet symbols.

messages.content: {"account_name": "Harbour Lane Studio", "segment": "smb", "edition": "standard", "next_edition": "premium", "arr": 4200, "seats_licensed": 40, "seats_assigned": 37, "seats_assigned_30_days_ago": 31, "seat_utilisation_pct": 93, "monthly_active_users": 33, "automation_rules": 2, "automation_rule_limit": 15, "integrations": 2, "integration_limit": 3, "assist_credits_used_30d": 0, "assist_credits_included": 10, "health_score": 58.0, "health_band": "yellow", "open_high_priority_tickets": 2, "latest_nps_score": 4, "days_to_renewal": 40, "trigger_signal": "expansion_ready", "trigger_evidence": "Expansion likelihood 55%", "expansion_score_pct": 55, "expansion_reasons": "seats are nearly full"}

content.text:
Signal: Expansion-ready signal fired on Harbour Lane Studio, an SMB account on Standard, with the model estimating a 55% expansion likelihood, driven by seats running nearly full.

Evidence: 37 of 40 licensed seats are assigned (93% utilisation), up from 31 assigned 30 days ago. Monthly active users are 33, and the account has 2 of 15 automation rules and 2 of 3 integrations in use.

Likely need: More seats, since assignment rose by 6 in 30 days and only 3 licensed seats remain open. Whether Premium fits is less clear from this data: automation and integration use are well below their limits, and Assist credits used in the last 30 days are 0 of 10 included, so the case for the next edition rests on seat growth more than on feature need.

Suggested opener: "Hi, I noticed your team has grown to 37 of your 40 seats, so I wanted to check whether you need more room before renewal and what would work best for you."

Risks: Health is yellow at 58.0, latest NPS is 4, and there are 2 open high-priority tickets. Renewal is 40 days away. Resolve or acknowledge the tickets before raising expansion, or the conversation may land badly.
